label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God formed man of the _____ of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verse: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
note: Adam's origin story — a handful of earth plus the breath of God equals a living soul.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is my _____, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verse: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
note: Jerusalem lay in ruins, yet the poet counts the LORD as his portion — and finds that enough to hope on.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jacob was left alone; and there _____ a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verse: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
note: Jacob wrestled until daybreak and walked away with a limp and a new name: Israel.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the _____, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
verse: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
note: Jonah grieved a one-night plant more than Nineveh's 120,000 people — and the book ends on God's unanswered question.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that _____ closer than a brother.
verse: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
note: 'A friend that sticketh closer than a brother' — preachers have long heard Jesus in this one.
